guesses.question: You wrote that Glass Harbour came into your life in the winter of 2021, and that a friend put Second Lamp on the radio that same winter. Did these two records come to you in the same season, at the same bakery job?

quotes.quote: Glass Harbour came into my life in the winter of 2021, when I worked night shifts at a bakery in Leeds
A friend at the bakery put Second Lamp on the radio during a night shift that same winter

what_it_did.quote: It made me slow down on that walk instead of rushing to bed.
That song kept me company until the ovens were done.
